items.text: Holistic energy solutions from Linde Material Handling

To rise to the business challenges of the future, you need to optimize how you use your energy today. That is why more and more companies are asking which energy system will best enable them to square productivity with environmental protection. The credo in intralogistics is: Maximize efficiency, reduce costs, increase sustainability.

From our many years of experience, we know that “One fits all” does not work. That is why we at Linde offer a comprehensive portfolio of different drives, batteries, chargers, and software tools, and tailor them to your individual goals. We provide expert consulting services to ensure that individual factors such as fleet size, network infrastructure, work processes, and production targets are taken into account.

Whatever the optimal solution for you is, be it a classic combustion engine, lead-acid battery, lithium-ion drive or fuel cell. With us, you get the best technology for your needs – for maximum performance and sustainability.
With optimal advice for the optimal solution

Every company has different requirements and expectations. That’s why Linde takes a holistic approach to energy consulting. We analyze where you’re starting from, taking into account aspects such as fleet, operations, infrastructure and sustainability goals, and focus on specific requirements rather than individual technologies or products.

We help you to choose the right drive system, support you with resource planning for your trucks, provide a tailor-made design of your energy infrastructure, and optimize your charging cycles. This brings a number of advantages:
Up to 40% reduction in energy costs
Optimization of the availability of your fleet
Avoidance of power peaks in the power supply
A simplified charging process for your drivers
Support in achieving your sustainability goals
Better use of your own energy sources

Lithium-ion batteries have a high energy density and deliver up to 30 percent more power than lead-acid batteries. They can be recharged at any time, which enables flexible 24/7 use without the need to change batteries. A multi-level safety system ensures maximum performance even under difficult conditions.

Lead-acid batteries are a cost-effective and reliable energy system based on proven technology. Easy battery replacement makes the trucks ideal for round-the-clock operation. You are guaranteed to find the truck that best meets your requirements in our wide range of models.

Our fuel-efficient diesel engines guarantee high handling capacities and maximum availability even under the toughest conditions. To reduce CO₂ emissions further, the trucks can be completely or partially powered by biofuels without additional conversion.

Fuel cells convert hydrogen into electricity, without emitting any CO₂. The trucks can be refueled quickly and easily, which guarantees maximum availability. Fuel cells are maintenance-free and therefore offer a long-lasting, reliable solution.

Gas-powered forklift trucks combine the power of an internal combustion engine with lower emissions. They are particularly quiet and provide a pleasant working environment. Owing to the lower exhaust emissions, gas forklifts are also suitable for indoor use. Depending on the model, they may be operated using either a propellant or natural gas.
Everything from a single source, everything from Linde

The integration of truck and energy system is a key factor in the energy efficiency and performance of forklift trucks and warehouse handling equipment. That is why we offer pallet trucks and stackers, tow tractors, reach trucks, electric forklift trucks, order pickers, narrow-aisle trucks, tugger trains, and our automated trucks with lead-acid and lithium-ion batteries and the associated chargers from our own development and production. It is also why we developed our own hydrogen technology and now manufacture the drive system for our pallet stackers and trucks, electric forklift trucks, tractors, order pickers and tugger trains with fuel cells.

The from Linde is an intelligent charge management system for electrically powered industrial trucks. It networks multiple chargers to monitor and coordinate current power consumption. The availability of the trucks in the overall process is largely decided at the charging station. However, charging several trucks at the same time can lead to peaks in consumption and thus to high costs. Linde offers an efficient solution with the connect:charger.
Gain a competitive advantage now with energy consulting from Linde Material Handling.

First came one test machine, then another two were added—and the aim is that soon, the entire fleet of 8-tonners will be powered by environmentally friendly lithium-ion technology. At leading mineral water producers Gerolsteiner, the Linde E80 offers impressive proof that electric forklift trucks have no trouble matching up to their combustion-powered equivalents.
Unbeatable Handling and Zero Emissions Guaranteed
With the ultimate goal of electrifying their entire fleet in the future, the specialists at Liebherr have tested the E160 electric forklift truck in action over the course of several weeks.
An Combustion Engine Stronghold Converts to Electric

It started with E and continues with X: The company Westfälische Drahtindustrie (WDI) is pushing for a switch from internal combustion to electric forklift trucks at its central German plant in Hamm. The Linde X50 puts in a convincing performance during the four-week field test, even with heavy loads.

How do you make your intralogistics more economical, cleaner, and more sustainable? For Emons Spedition GmbH, the answer was clear: by switching from LPG forklifts to lithium-ion units in the general cargo warehouse in Großbeeren.

More flexible, cost-effective, and robust: In the highly frequented general cargo warehouse in Heilbronn, the Fritz Group has switched its industrial trucks from lead-acid battery operation to modern Linde lithium-ion technology.

Anyone brewing and bottling millions of hectoliters of Pilsener beer, shandy, malt beer, apple beer and other mixed beer beverages needs powerful intralogistics systems to get the drinks onto the street. C. & A. Veltins, a brewery with a rich tradition, has put its faith in forklifts from Linde Material Handling for this demanding role.
Innovative battery technology for forklift trucks

Electric drives are the future of mobility. This applies not only to cars, but also to forklift trucks. The key to this are new battery concepts, primarily based on lithium-ion technology. What are the advantages and disadvantages of different types of batteries? Where is the lithium-ion battery going? And how can users make the best possible use of them?
Maximum indoor goods handling: The Linde E14 – E20 with swivel steering axle are super-agile and come with a wide range of energy solutions.
The Ei14 – Ei20 electric forklift trucks with integrated Li-ION battery combine agility and comfort for efficient use in standard indoor applications.
Efficient load handling: Linde E16 – E20 P electric forklift trucks are maneuverable, flexible and offer numerous energy options.
Powerful, robust, agile, and spacious: The counterbalance forklift trucks Xi16 – Xi20 P from Linde set new standards as a four-wheeled version.
Linde Material Handling supports the automotive industry in the key challenges of intralogistics: ensuring production flow, saving costs, using automation, protecting the environment.

Ground handling is a challenge for airport logistics. The demands on industrial trucks and logistics solutions are correspondingly high. Demand is for robust vehicles that enable fast and safe handling and are increasingly focusing on alternative drive systems.
Forklift expert confirms: Linde sets new records for performance, ergonomics, and energy efficiency with its new Xi models.
The Xi16 – Xi20 RP electric counterbalanced forklift truck combines unparalleled all-round visibility, maneuverability, and safety for maximum efficiency.
Pioneering visibility, compact maneuverability, and high performance: The Xi14 – Xi20 electric counterbalanced forklift trucks from Linde Material Handling.
As a three-wheeled version, the counterbalance forklift trucks Xi10 – Xi20 from Linde set new standards when it comes to performance, maneuverability and space.

The best of both worlds – for the best that nature has to offer. That’s the best way to describe the pilot run of the new Linde X35 at German soft drinks manufacturer, Ensinger Mineral-Heilquellen. The new electric forklift truck performance class impressed the managers of the long-established mineral water brand, not only in terms of sustainability, but also with its outstanding performance.

For decades now, Linde forklift trucks have been distinguished by their design, for which the honor goes to none other than Porsche Engineering. The most recent achievement of this progressive partnership: the new generation of Linde Counterbalanced Forklift Trucks X20 – X35 and H20 – H35.
